text: Mama Tee's Bakery - Opening Hours: We are open Monday to Saturday from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM. On Sundays we open from 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM. We are closed on public holidays, with one exception: on Christmas Eve we open from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Custom cake orders can be collected at any time during opening hours.

Mama Tee's Bakery - Menu and Prices: Meat pie: N1,500. Sausage roll: N1,200. Chin chin (small bag): N2,000. Zobo drink: N1,000. Cupcakes, box of 6: N6,500. Birthday cakes (plain vanilla): 8-inch costs N18,000 and 10-inch costs N26,000. Fondant decoration adds N5,000 to any cake. Prices may change with notice on our WhatsApp page.

Mama Tee's Bakery - Custom Cake Orders: Custom cakes need at least 5 days notice. Tiered and wedding cakes need at least 7 days notice. To confirm an order, we collect a 50% deposit. The balance is paid on pickup or before delivery. Design changes are free until 48 hours before pickup. After that we cannot change the design.

Mama Tee's Bakery - Delivery: We deliver within Lagos only. Delivery to Lagos Mainland costs N2,500. Delivery to Lagos Island costs N4,000. Delivery is free for orders above N50,000. Place your order before 11:00 AM for same-day delivery. We do not deliver on Sundays.

Mama Tee's Bakery - Refunds and Returns: Fresh baked goods cannot be returned. If your order arrives damaged or wrong, send a photo within 2 hours of delivery. We will then offer a replacement or a refund. Approved refunds are paid within 3 working days to your original payment method. Cake deposits are refundable only if you cancel at least 72 hours before pickup.

Mama Tee's Bakery - Allergen Information: Our products contain wheat, eggs and milk. Our kitchen also handles peanuts and tree nuts, so we cannot guarantee any item is nut-free. We do not currently offer vegan or gluten-free products. Please tell us about allergies when you order, and we will advise you honestly.

Mama Tee's Bakery - Payment Methods: We accept bank transfer, card payment through a Paystack link, and cash on pickup. After a bank transfer, send a screenshot of the receipt on WhatsApp so we can confirm your order. We do not accept cheques or cryptocurrency.
Mama Tee's Bakery - Contact Us: WhatsApp: +234 800 000 0000. Email: hello@mamatees.example. Shop address: 12 Sample Street, Surulere, Lagos. We reply to messages within 2 hours during opening hours.

Mama Tee's Bakery - Sweet Points Loyalty Program: Earn 1 Sweet Point for every N1,000 you spend. Collect 50 points to get N2,500 off your next order. Points expire 12 months after you earn them. Points cannot be combined with discount codes.

Mama Tee's Bakery - Catering for Events: We cater events for 30 guests or more. The minimum catering order is N150,000. Please book at least 14 days ahead. A tasting session costs N5,000, and this amount is deducted from your final bill if you book with us. Setup is included for events inside Lagos.
